title: Annular liquid jets: solvers and data for exact constraint absorption and finite-time loss of global admissibility
description: Chebyshev collocation and independent upwind finite-difference solvers for the one-dimensional annular-liquid-jet model, together with the drivers and data supporting the revised manuscript. Version v1.1.0 adds global-admissibility detection, independent cross-validation of the first interior contact, quadratic-contact diagnostics, componentwise off-grid residuals, temporal and periodicity tests, linear frequency response, corrected N+2 Gauss--Legendre volume quadrature, and a finite-thickness closure-absorption audit.
notes: Version v1.1.0 accompanies the revised Physics of Fluids submission. The peer-review revision calculations were reproduced on the UMA SCBI Picasso cluster as Slurm array job 2405358.
